meta.name: The Emotional Net Worth Plan
meta.subtitle: A daily system for peace in the mind, love in the heart, happiness in the state of being, and personal freedom.
meta.source: Joe, 2026-09-11. His framework, his words. Recorded in full at docs/joe-emotional-net-worth.md.
meta.voiceNote: Every string here is member-facing. Use affirmative construction, full word forms rather than contractions, and a period or comma where an em dash would sit.

premise.analogy: A person meets a financial advisor to weigh assets, understand liabilities, set goals, invest consistently, and build a plan for long-term freedom. This applies that same structure to emotional and spiritual well-being.
premise.equation: Emotional Net Worth = Emotional Assets − Emotional Liabilities
premise.informationLine: Every emotion carries information, and the practice turns that information into wisdom.

transformations.intro: Six feelings arrive carrying energy that is ready to be acknowledged, understood, and integrated.

pairs.line: You meet what is here, and you belong to yourself again.
You take hold of your own part, and your power returns with it.
You release what was carried, and the weight sets itself down.
You step toward what is still unseen, and it holds.
The heat becomes fuel, and the fuel becomes direction.
You lay it down, and you walk lighter for the rest of the way.

steps.title: Assess
steps.detail: What is increasing your peace, love and happiness today. Which feeling is asking for compassionate attention. Where your emotional energy is flowing.

steps.title: Integrate the inner child
steps.line: The inner child is seen, heard, loved, and welcomed.
steps.detail: The adult self becomes the loving internal parent.

steps.title: Cultivate clarity through the ABCs
steps.line: Clear language for the qualities you choose to embody.
steps.detail: Each letter becomes an emotional asset, a guiding principle, and an intentional action. The ABCs help you choose who you are being and where your attention goes today.

steps.title: Embody the work through The Answer®
steps.detail: Intentional breathing, movement, mindfulness, and a settled nervous system.

steps.title: Make daily emotional investments
steps.line: Fifteen intentional minutes, deposited every day.
steps.detail: Breathing, movement, gratitude, affirmative language, reflection, self-love, connection, and autosuggestion. Small daily deposits compound into lasting inner wealth.

steps.title: Review and rebalance
steps.line: One weekly look at the whole balance sheet.
steps.detail: Five questions, once a week, with the people beside you.

innerChild.line: I see you. I hear you. I love you. You are safe with me. We are creating together now.
innerChild.note: The adult self, speaking as the loving internal parent.
innerChild.echo: Your circle answers a raised hand the same way: I see you. I am with you. The words a member offers themselves are the words their circle offers them.

weeklyReview.title: The weekly Emotional Net Worth review
weeklyReview.intro: Once a week, each person asks:
questions: Where did I give and receive love?
Which feeling is ready for loving attention?
What am I intentionally investing in this week?
weeklyReview.placement: This is the weekly Circle beat. Sharpen already gathers eight people once a week on the movement boundary, and these five questions are what that gathering is for.

sharpenFit.already: The daily practice. Already fifteen minutes, already every day.
Twenty-eight days of letters, live since March.
The workout, the breath engine, the journal.
The Circle of eight, meeting on Root, Turn, Gather and Carry. The questions fill a gathering that was waiting for them.
Sharpen itself. The partner, the circle, the anchor.
The circle's answer to a raised hand, in the same words.
Your Proof counts what a member did rather than scoring them. The balance sheet is the same instinct, widened.
